answer: One concrete mechanism: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because island only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, atlas is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any bridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
